summary: Iteration 3 covers the auth/CORS hardening plus the broadcast/tournament/squad/home redesign. Added 24 new backend tests (test_arena_new_features.py) for auth-response tokens + Secure/SameSite=None cookies, Bearer /auth/me, JSON /auth/refresh, bogus /auth/google/session returning 401 JSON (no 500), CORS preflight, /api/stats, /api/course/start real HTML, coach shout /runs/{id}/hint (401/404/409/finished/non-crab), /api/tournaments (402 free, 422 invalid, 409 existing, list, bracket shape) and /api/squad (default, bad formation 422, foreign crab 404, valid PUT + GET persistence, unauth 401). Backend: 67/68 pass (23/24 new + full existing suite minus 2 long-running LLM tests that are covered in iteration 2). The single failing test is a Cloudflare edge/ingress override — see RCA. Frontend: fully verified /home (hero, CTA, stats bar, 4-slide carousel), /arena guest self-report -> signin-modal with login+close btns, Google OAuth callback simulation (intercept /auth/google/session with a real login response) -> lands signed-in on /arena, no redirect loop to /login, hash cleared. Signed-in /login redirects to /arena. Signed-in Get course link returns absolute course URL that serves real station HTML. Broadcast on /arena and /course renders 3D stadium canvas, scoreboard-a (+b for duels), run-timer, minimap, coach-bar (input disabled when no live own-crab run), slide-in callouts (WALL CLEARED! / OFF THE LINE! observed), broadcast-replay-btn works, tournament-panel with bracket + neon champion-card (existing 2-entrant tournament from iteration 2 verified — champion GPT Pincer), squad-card with formation-diagram + all controls. Did NOT start any new real tournament (each match ~90s) — spec explicitly cautions against this.

minor.issue: Cloudflare/ingress edge intercepts OPTIONS preflights and returns a fixed Access-Control-Allow-Origin = the cluster deploy URL (https://<id>.cluster-8.preview.emergentcf.cloud) instead of echoing the request Origin. Direct backend hits (127.0.0.1:8001) correctly echo the origin per CORS_ORIGIN_REGEX. Browsers on any *.emergentagent.com origin would see a CORS mismatch on preflight. Backend code is correct; this is an infra/edge config issue only visible through the public URL.

issues: During a champion replay the callouts stack in the upper-left corner and can briefly overlap the scoreboard on 1080p viewports; cosmetic only.
Chromium 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels' warning persists from r3f canvases (cosmetic, called out in iteration 2).

action_items: Investigate Cloudflare/ingress OPTIONS handling for the preview URL — the edge overrides Access-Control-Allow-Origin with a fixed cluster domain. Backend CORS middleware is correct; the edge should either forward OPTIONS to the backend or reflect the configured allowed origins. If this is preview-only behaviour, no action needed for prod, but note it in release docs.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py: set_session uses COOKIE={'samesite':'none'} — starlette lowercases to 'none' which is correct. Cookies + JSON tokens are both returned; frontend api.js saves them into localStorage and falls back to Bearer. Good defence for cross-site cookie blockers.

arena_api.play_match: on start_run HTTPException it sets error and returns entrant `a` as the surviving fighter; if both entrants raise (e.g. no key) `a` is still returned as winner even though its run never started. Consider returning None or marking the match as bye/error so the champion isn't a crab that never actually ran.

server.shout_hint validates ownership + status but pushes hint even if the last run step already exceeded max_steps — fine because status check catches it, but the pending_hints list is unbounded. Consider capping to N or using $push with $slice.
arena_api.entrant_of allows adapter=='crab' only via crab_id path; passing adapter='crab' with no crab_id => 422 message says 'champion adapter id' which is slightly misleading. Cosmetic.

arena_api.SquadBody.slots is a free-form dict; extra keys are silently dropped when writing (only ROLES kept). Fine, but no 422 on unknown role keys — user could paste any JSON. Consider a strict Pydantic model with per-role Optional[str] fields.

Broadcast.jsx CoachBar identifies the coach target by run.user_id === user.id; if IDs are string-compared this works, but the earlier data-testid path only works when the Coach's live target run is *this user's own crab* (adapter==='crab'). Confirmed matches server-side gating. Good.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (home, guest arena, Google callback simulation, signed-in /login redirect, course URL, broadcast on /arena + /course, squad, tournament bracket)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run backend tests: `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_arena_backend.py tests/test_arena_new_features.py -v`. Login endpoint IP-rate-limited to 10/60s — space runs or add sleep(65) between full-suite passes. For Playwright, simulate Google OAuth by page.route()'ing **/api/auth/google/session and fulfilling with the response of a real POST /api/auth/login for any seeded account, then goto /arena#session_id=fake. Avoid creating new tournaments — each match runs a real ~90s LLM call. The 1 pytest CORS failure is not backend code; it's the Cloudflare edge substituting the ACAO on OPTIONS.
rca of the issue: TestCORS::test_preflight_emergentagent_origin fails because the Cloudflare/ingress edge (which fronts the preview URL) intercepts OPTIONS and returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin = https://<id>.cluster-8.preview.emergentcf.cloud (its own hostname) regardless of the request Origin. Reproduced by `curl -i -X OPTIONS <backend-url>/api/auth/login -H 'Origin: https://x.preview.emergentagent.com' -H 'Access-Control-Request-Method: POST'`. Hitting the backend directly (curl to http://127.0.0.1:8001/...) returns ACAO=echoed origin correctly, proving the CORSMiddleware regex `^https://([a-z0-9-]+\.)*(emergentagent\.com|emergent\.host|emergentcf\.cloud)$` and allow_credentials=True are configured correctly. Mitigation: either configure the CF/ingress to pass OPTIONS to origin, or add all expected browser origins to CORS_ORIGINS. No app code change needed.
